claims.text: Pulumi can reference existing Terraform state files.
Any Terraform provider can be used in Pulumi programs.
Terraform modules can be imported and used directly in Pulumi.
HCL code can be converted to Pulumi code.
Terraform and Pulumi deployments can be orchestrated together.
`pulumi import` can be used to bring Terraform-managed resources under Pulumi management.
The `pulumi import` CLI command supports the syntax `pulumi import aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc main-vpc vpc-12345` to import an existing AWS VPC resource.
The `pulumi import` CLI command supports the syntax `pulumi import aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet private-subnet-1 subnet-67890` to import an existing AWS subnet resource.
The `pulumi import` CLI command supports the syntax `pulumi import aws:ecs/cluster:Cluster app-cluster my-cluster` to import an existing AWS ECS cluster resource.
There exists a `terraform.state.S3Reference` resource/class (in `@pulumi/terraform`) that accepts `bucket` and `key` arguments to reference Terraform state stored in S3.
`pulumi.StackReference` provides a `getOutput` method to retrieve outputs from another stack, e.g. `coreInfra.getOutput("vpcId")`.
The `@pulumi/policy` package exports a `PolicyPack` class and a `validateResourceOfType` function.
Pulumi Policy Packs support an `enforcementLevel` field with a `"mandatory"` value.
The Automation API is exposed via importing `@pulumi/pulumi/automation`.
`pulumi.LocalWorkspace.createOrSelectStack` is a method that creates or selects a stack given a `stackName` and `projectName`.
A Pulumi Automation API stack object supports a `setConfig` method, e.g. `stack.setConfig("aws:region", { value: "us-west-2" })`.
A Pulumi Automation API stack object supports an `up` method that accepts an `onOutput` callback option, e.g. `stack.up({ onOutput: console.log })`.
Pulumi provides a `pulumi.ComponentResource` base class that can be extended to create custom component resources.
Pulumi resource options support a `parent` field to establish resource parent-child relationships.
Pulumi provides a `pulumi.interpolate` tagged template function for embedding Output values in strings.
Pulumi component resources support a `registerOutputs` method for registering the resource's outputs.

This guide is intended for Terraform users ready to deepen their integration with Pulumi or consider migration to Pulumi.
The Automation API example's `desiredCount` argument to `aws.ecs.Service` accepts a numeric value.
AWS ECS task definitions support a `requiresCompatibilities` field that accepts the value `"FARGATE"`.
AWS ECS task definitions support a `networkMode` field that accepts the value `"awsvpc"`.
The `aws.ecs.Service` resource supports a `launchType` argument and a `networkConfiguration` argument with a `subnets` field.
AWS S3 bucket ACL values include `"public-read"` and `"public-read-write"` to denote public accessibility.
